config.scope: Validate the three-consecutive-channel detection operator and measure its selection bias in controlled cubes. This is a synthetic instrument/source control linked to the THINGS detection prescription, not a reconstructed publisher mask or admitted real-galaxy selection function.

detection.rule: Mark the union of all voxels in qualifying triples at the same sky pixel; do not join separate channel intervals.
detection.noise_scale: Oracle known marginal sigma=1. This isolates selection bias even when the noise amplitude is correctly known.

simulation.spatial_noise: Independent native pixels filtered by the nominal circular native restoring-beam surrogate and the additional detection Gaussian. Pad the white-noise field by the full kernel support and crop to avoid artificial boundary variance loss. Normalize the exact convolution-kernel variance to one.
simulation.spectral_noise: Full Hanning uses an extended independent sequence with a three-tap filter. Decimated Hanning retains every second filtered sample (lag-one correlation 1/6); full Hanning has lag-one 2/3. Normalize all marginal variances to one. These are declared alternatives, not measured THINGS responses.

sources.placement: Centered at spatial and spectral array centers. Apply the same spatial and spectral response to signal, then normalize its observed peak to the declared SNR.
sources.scope: Known finite sampled positive Gaussian scenes; no deprojection, mass conversion, physical orbit or gravity model enters.
sources.spectral_width_units: Intrinsic FWHM in units of retained output channel spacing; generate the decimated branch on a half-spacing parent grid, filter, then retain alternate samples.

statistics: Fraction of pure-noise voxels admitted by the mask
Probability the known source peak is included
Fraction of known noiseless source flux inside the selected mask
Selected measured flux divided by known input source flux, including selected-noise bias
independent_benchmarks: Three-channel mask against explicit interval examples including separated pairs and boundary triples
Cube filtering against per-plane direct convolution
Filtered white-noise covariance and variance against convolution-kernel moments
nonclaims: Successful recovery of these templates does not establish completeness for real asymmetric or streaming gas
Oracle noise amplitude is not a fitted or independently validated actual noise model
Shared noise draws across injection strengths give paired controls, not independent experiments
No mask parameter is selected to improve MOND or Newtonian residuals
